tools.name: batch-call
tools.title: Execute multiple MCP tool calls in one internal batch with stop/continue behavior and resume metadata.
tools.description: Execute multiple MCP tool calls in one internal batch with stop/continue behavior and resume metadata.

calls.description: Ordered list of tool calls to execute.

tool.description: MCP tool name (for example: project-list, databaseobject-tree-get).

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the target tool.

executionId.description: Optional execution identifier returned in resume metadata.

optimizeMutations.description: When true (default), mutation tool calls are executed with deferred refresh/save/build finalization.

tools.name: databaseobject-delete
tools.title: Removes a database object from the project tree.
tools.description: Removes a database object from the project tree.

tools.name: databaseobject-move
tools.title: Moves or reorders a database object within the project tree.
tools.description: Moves or reorders a database object within the project tree.

tools.name: databaseobject-rename
tools.title: Renames a database object and optionally refactors references.
tools.description: Renames a database object and optionally refactors references.

tools.name: databaseobject-schema
tools.title: Returns schema/sample for a database object (qname). Supports type=xml|json|jsonschema and internal=true to get request schemas. Omits empty fields.
tools.description: Returns schema/sample for a database object (qname). Supports type=xml|json|jsonschema and internal=true to get request schemas. Omits empty fields.

tools.name: databaseobject-search
tools.title: Search database objects (name/comment/QName).
tools.description: Search database objects (name/comment/QName).

tools.name: databaseobject-tree-apply
tools.title: Apply a canonical object tree patch to a target QName using the batch upsert engine.
tools.description: Apply a canonical object tree patch to a target QName using the batch upsert engine.

tools.name: databaseobject-tree-get
tools.title: Return a canonical database object tree compatible with upsertTree format.
tools.description: Return a canonical database object tree compatible with upsertTree format.

tools.name: log-view
tools.title: Reads engine/studio logs through LogManager with filters and pagination.
tools.description: Reads engine/studio logs through LogManager with filters and pagination.

tools.name: marketplace-import
tools.title: Imports a marketplace project into workspace and optionally renames starters.
tools.description: Imports a marketplace project into workspace and optionally renames starters.

importedProjectName.description: Optional new name for imported workspace project. Required for starters.

tools.name: marketplace-list
tools.title: Lists marketplace projects with search/topics and cursor pagination.
tools.description: Lists marketplace projects with search/topics and cursor pagination.

tools.name: mobile-builder-open
tools.title: Launch NGX mobile builder in Studio and return the detected Node listening URL.
tools.description: Launch NGX mobile builder in Studio and return the detected Node listening URL.

forceRestart.description: When true, always restart the builder even if a live instance is already running.

tools.name: palette-describe
tools.title: Describes palette entries (properties, creation hints).
tools.description: Describes palette entries (properties, creation hints).

tools.name: palette-list
tools.title: Lists creatable palette entries for a target parent, including NGX dynamic components using Studio-compatible rules.
tools.description: Lists creatable palette entries for a target parent, including NGX dynamic components using Studio-compatible rules.

tools.name: project-js-get
tools.title: Project JS Get
tools.description: Read a helper script from the project's js directory

tools.name: project-js-set
tools.title: Project JS Set
tools.description: Write or replace a helper script in the project's js directory

tools.name: project-list
tools.title: Lists installed Convertigo projects with metadata for MCP admin tooling.
tools.description: Lists installed Convertigo projects with metadata for MCP admin tooling.

tools.name: project-reload
tools.title: Reload a Convertigo project from disk (discard unsaved runtime state).
tools.description: Reload a Convertigo project from disk (discard unsaved runtime state).

tools.name: project-save
tools.title: Save a Convertigo project to disk (engine export).
tools.description: Save a Convertigo project to disk (engine export).

tools.name: rag-query
tools.title: Query Convertigo knowledge base
tools.description:
Use when you are unsure how to use Convertigo (features, setup, APIs, best practices, or troubleshooting).
Queries the Convertigo RAG/guides and returns practical guidance. Typical response time: 30-60 seconds.

tools.name: requestable-execute
tools.title: Execute
tools.description: Execute

variables.description: Request variables JSON object. Can be passed as a JSON string or object.

recordSchema.description: When true on transactions, records response schema to disk (writeSchemaToFile).

includeLogs.description: When true, appends execution logs captured during the requestable call.
